answers.core: It's a request to change/enhance the functionality of a core node.
answers.workaround:
I do think this enhancement would fundamentally improve the development/play of any driving related games, because players/developers might not be aware of this limitation(it doesn't seem to be mentioned )

In my particular game, this is surmountable by cutting throttle percentage to slow down instead of using the brakes, and faking braking vfx/sfx, but more complex games wouldn't be able to move around it as easy, maybe through manually calculating a difference between engine and brake and applying whichever side is positive.

title: Make VehicleWheel3D able to brake and accelerate at the same time
